messages:
Sam: FYI perf alert after last runtime change — short seq requests (<=64) P99 up ~90ms, overall CPU up ~18% on hosts.
Priya: Saw that. Quick flame: host_parse_tokenize ~28%, kernel_choice ~25%, kv_store::evict_loop ~15%, grpc::write_small ~10%.
Jorge: Can repro locally with bench. Interesting spike in write syscalls and increased page/cache misses.
Sam: Logged flame (trimmed):
```
host_parse_tokenize 28%
kernel_choice 25%
kv_store::evict_loop 15%
grpc::write_small 10%
other 22%
```
Lin: Two ideas: (A) force "minimal" kernel for small seqs to avoid codepath flip, (B) introduce a lightweight kvcache pin for recently-used prefixes to reduce eviction churn.
Priya: Also consider batching heuristic tune: avoid forcing batcher to combine 1-2 token bursts if latency sensitive. The new heuristic may be over-eager.
Jorge: I tested adding http2 coalesce (host flag: --egress-coalesce=8) — syscall rate dropped 35%, P99 improved ~45ms. Will run combined tests.
Sam: Repro command: `./perf/bench --workload=chat-short --seq=48 --batchhint=auto --concurrency=60 --capture=flame`
deploy-bot: Canary started: ingress-hosting commit=def456 egress_coalesce=8 target=12% :rocket:
Priya: I'll prototype kernel-affinity fast-path (seq<=64 && batch<=4) and add unit tests. Gate on new microbench.
Lin: I'll add kvcache pin hint metadata + microbench measuring evictions/syscalls.
Jorge: We should also record netstat -s and /proc/vmstat during canary to capture socket stalls + page reclaim.
Sam: Plan: (1) canary with egress coalesce, (2) submit kernel-affinity PR, (3) submit kvcache-pin PR. If canary metrics are good roll to 100%.
Priya: TL;DR: path flip + write syscall tail -> kvcache thrash -> p99 regression. Mitigations: kernel-affinity fast-path, kvcache pin, http/gRPC write coalesce.
Lin: +1
Sam: Thanks all, will coordinate rollout.
file_notes: Host-side perf regression thread: kernel choice, batch heuristics, KV eviction, small-write syscall coalescing; includes repro command and canary info
